clips.title: The story
paras: The Angerfang Encampment is the primary stronghold of the Dragonmaw clan in the central Wetlands. Led by Chieftain Nek'rosh Skullcrusher, these renegade orcs use the sprawling camp as a staging ground to threaten nearby dwarven settlements and plot the destruction of Menethil Harbor.

Sprawling across the muck of the central Wetlands, the Angerfang Encampment serves as the fortified heart of Dragonmaw power in the region. Unlike the scattered raiding parties found wandering the marshes, this compound boasts heavily defended barricades, watchtowers, and a formidable host of warriors, bonewarders, and dark spellcasters loyal to the old ways. From here, the Dragonmaw project military force across the marshlands, raiding travelers along the roads and menacing nearby dwarven digs like Whelgar's Excavation Site.
